scopeRule: v18.2.0 immutable Admin/Presence/Sessions scope is preserved. Source-changing utility remediations discovered after G1 are mandatory v18.3.0 G1-G3 inputs before hosted implementation proceeds.

items.name: Dashboard
items.plan: Merge overlapping Market Intelligence, alternative-context and options/context summary blocks into one compact Context Intelligence hierarchy while preserving Decision Queue and material risk priority.
items.acceptance: Dashboard has one market/context summary hierarchy; deep evidence remains in canonical specialist surfaces; no lost material risk or decision input.

items.name: Market Intelligence
items.plan: Recompose into Market State, Leadership & Liquidity, Events & Risk, Context Intelligence, and supporting research/validation sections; move implementation-learning machinery deeper or to Maintenance where appropriate.
items.acceptance: All useful canonical evidence remains accessible without multiple equal-priority context homes or normal-user implementation machinery.

items.name: Day Trade Desk
items.plan: Keep deterministic decision/plan/readiness and compact material event/risk context; move full repeated News/Earnings/SEC evidence to Research deep home.
items.acceptance: Day workflow remains complete and faster to scan; protected formula unchanged; Research contains deep evidence.

items.name: Swing Desk
items.plan: Keep deterministic swing decision/readiness plus compact material context; remove repeated deep ticker evidence in favor of Research drill-down.
items.acceptance: Swing workflow preserves all material decisions/risks with no duplicate deep-evidence home.

items.name: Long-Term Desk
items.plan: Retain horizon-relevant fundamental summary but route full SEC/ownership/catalyst evidence to Research.
items.acceptance: Long-Term remains decision-complete while Research is the canonical detailed evidence destination.

items.name: Discovery Scanner
items.plan: Introduce one bounded canonical broad-snapshot broker/cache with freshness and in-flight request coalescing shared by Scanner and Opportunity Radar; preserve distinct ranking logic.
items.acceptance: A fresh equivalent Alpaca snapshot batch is not independently fetched by Scanner and Radar for the same symbols/window; ranking behavior remains distinct and tested.

items.name: Opportunity Radar
items.plan: Consume the shared broad-snapshot broker/cache and canonical market-activity/event evidence; retain always-on promotion lifecycle and adaptive cadence.
items.acceptance: Radar remains always-on/bounded but shares fresh acquisition with Scanner and records avoided duplicate calls.

items.name: Pre-Market Prep
items.plan: Formalize a Session Intelligence Coordinator and model Pre-Market Prep as a temporal freshness/prewarm checkpoint over canonical state and shared refresh scheduler/router/cache.
items.acceptance: Pre-Market Prep owns no parallel market-analysis or broad provider acquisition pipeline and produces a concise readiness/change outcome.

items.name: Market Open Prep
items.plan: Place the 9:20–9:25 ET reconciliation checkpoint under the same Session Intelligence Coordinator, reusing canonical overnight/premarket evidence and only refreshing due material inputs.
items.acceptance: Market Open Prep remains a distinct temporal checkpoint without duplicating Scanner/Radar/Event acquisition or analysis engines.

items.name: Earnings & Material Catalyst Reaction Watch
items.plan: Make Event Intelligence the explicit lifecycle owner for scheduled/material trigger → reaction → outcome tracking; reuse canonical Earnings/News/SEC/quote/liquidity evidence and Rapid Move correlation.
items.acceptance: No separate broad polling engine; event lifecycle remains selective, correlated, deduplicated and outcome-tracked.

items.name: Market Activity Seeds
items.plan: Keep Market Activity as a reusable Discovery/Radar input and optional explanation/drill-down, but remove it as an equal/prominent normal-user decision surface.
items.acceptance: Discovery still uses seeds; USER-facing hierarchy presents Radar/Scanner outcomes rather than raw acquisition ingredients.

items.name: Legacy standalone News/Earnings/Filings routes
items.plan: Retire or redirect legacy standalone evidence pages: ticker Earnings/SEC/News go to Research subviews; market-wide material events go to Market Intelligence/Event Intelligence.
items.acceptance: No broken links; one canonical deep evidence home per workflow; legacy direct routes redirect safely or are removed with regression coverage.

items.name: Maintenance
items.plan: Group preparation/event operational truth under Session & Event Intelligence diagnostics while preserving provider/runtime/cache/validation ownership; keep Settings as configuration only.
items.acceptance: Operational visibility remains complete without repetitive equal-level job panels or user-facing intelligence duplication.
